t: Energer ENB769SRG 700W electric spray gun offers efficient and rapid application for various coatings. The 240V paint sprayer is suitable for all standard water or solvent-based paints and varnishes, ideal for decorators tackling large surfaces in both residential and commercial projects. Features a powerful 700W motor and 0.9L reservoir to ensure continuous operation, delivering a maximum flow of 1000ml/min with a controlled 0.3 bar spray pressure. The HVLP system provides precise coverage through 3 adjustable spray patterns – horizontal, vertical, and circular – minimising overspray and material waste. A 2.5mm nozzle and 2m hose offer flexibility during use.
